title: A Testing Method for Detector Error Models in Quantum Error Correction Compilers
abstract: arXiv:2611.20501v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A quantum error correction (QEC) compiler produces, from a code and a noise model, both the physical circuit to execute and a detector error model (DEM). The DEM lists the probability of each error mechanism and the measurements it flips. Decoders consume the DEM without verification, so a defect that describes the noise incorrectly calibrates the decoder against wrong rates and silently degrades the logical error rate. Existing techniques for testing quantum software judge correctness by crashes or by statistics of sampled outputs. DEM defects that only distort rates lie below what sampling can resolve at the error rates where QEC operates. We present DEMVal, a testing method that validates each model the compiler emits against a reconstructed reference, with rates obtained from outside the compiler under test. It compares the two models exactly, so its sensitivity is independent of the physical error rate. The reference can be built in

translated_title: 量子纠错编译器中检测器错误模型的测试方法
translated_abstract: 量子纠错（QEC）编译器根据量子码和噪声模型，生成可执行的物理电路以及检测器错误模型（DEM）。DEM 列出了每种错误机制的概率及其翻转的测量结果。解码器在未经校验的情况下直接使用 DEM，因此若 DEM 存在错误描述噪声的缺陷，就会导致解码器基于错误的错误率进行校准，从而悄然降低逻辑错误率。现有的量子软件测试技术通过崩溃或采样输出的统计特性来判断正确性，而在 QEC 实际运行的错误率下，仅扭曲错误率的 DEM 缺陷低于采样所能分辨的范围。我们提出了 DEMVal，一种测试方法，它将编译器输出的每个模型与重建的参考模型进行验证，其中错误率从被测编译器之外获取。该方法精确比较两个模型，因此其灵敏度与物理错误率无关。参考模型可以构建于……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出 DEMVal，一种量子纠错编译器检测器错误模型的测试方法，通过精确比较编译器输出与外部重建的参考模型，实现与物理错误率无关的缺陷检测灵敏度。
en_tdlr: DEMVal is a testing method for detector error models in quantum error correction compilers that exactly compares compiler-emitted models against externally reconstructed references, achieving defect-detection sensitivity independent of the physical error rate.
